# A quieter place to write

A lightweight **Markdown editor** with your references close at hand.

## Your document, your files

- Write with live formatting
- Keep notes as ordinary Markdown files
- Read PDFs alongside your writing

> Simple tools leave more room for your thoughts.

| Feature | Ready |
| --- | --- |
| Markdown editing | Yes |
| Local files | Yes |
| PDF reference pane | Yes |
